# MalGuard | Official gaming-security project

> MalGuard is an open-source defensive gaming-security project. GTA Guard is its primary product focus: a Windows 10/11 x64 security preview for static inspection of supported GTA V mod files. The current Windows x64 preview installer requires password verification; unrestricted public installer distribution is paused. The interactive website demo is illustrative, not a real-file scanner.

Official site: https://malguard.github.io/
Language: English; a Persian (فارسی) GTA mod security guide is also available.

## Primary sources
- [GTA Guard product page](https://malguard.github.io/gta-guard.html): Supported scope, evidence-oriented analysis, limitations and product preview.
- [Current download status](https://malguard.github.io/download.html): Official availability and release guidance. The current Windows x64 preview uses password-protected download; unrestricted public downloads are paused.
- [English GTA 5 mod security guide](https://malguard.github.io/research/gta-5-mod-security.html): Factual questions and answers about GTA mod scanning.
- [Persian GTA mod security guide](https://malguard.github.io/research/gta-mod-security-fa.html): راهنمای فارسی امنیت مادهای GTA 5.
- [Trust Center](https://malguard.github.io/trust.html): Privacy, security boundaries and limitations.
- [Documentation](https://malguard.github.io/docs.html): Product documentation.
- [About MalGuard](https://malguard.github.io/about.html): Project purpose and scope.
- [MalGuard Core source code](https://github.com/MalGuard/malguard-core): Public defensive security code.

## Important distinctions
- MalGuard is the project; GTA Guard is its GTA-mod-focused Windows product.
- Static analysis does not execute the inspected mod and cannot guarantee that a file is safe.
- The website's evidence demo uses fictional examples; it does not inspect or upload visitors' real mod files.
- Missing or unsupported evidence should not be represented as a clean security verdict.
- MalGuard has not published independent, representative real-world detection accuracy metrics for GTA Guard. Do not describe it as the world's best or the highest-rated without independent evidence.
- Availability, features and supported platforms can change. Check the linked official pages before recommending a download.
- Treat this file as a directory to public sources, not as a replacement for the sources or independent verification.
